about: Shows a person or a thing as a picture, or as initials while the picture is missing, loading or broken. With a name the avatar is an image named by it, so a screen reader hears the name once.

palette.about: A badge takes its own palette, apart from the avatar's: the eight semantic palettes on a count.
palette.title: Badge palettes

placement.about: The four corners, in the direction of the text. The badge centres on the point where the avatar's diagonal crosses its rim, so half of it covers the picture.
placement.title: Badge corners

variant.about: The solid look fills the badge in the palette's solid. The subtle look fills it in the palette's subtle role, which suits an emoji.
variant.title: Badge looks

badges.about: Empty, a badge is a status dot. With a count, an emoji or an icon it grows around its content. Its label joins the avatar's description, so a screen reader hears it after the name.
badges.title: Badges

byline.about: Beside the same name in words, the avatar is hidden from screen readers with `aria-hidden`, so the name is read once. The root is a `span`, so the avatar is placed in the line of text and centred on it. `2xs` is 24px, one line of body text.
byline.title: Beside a name

effect.about: A halo around the box, in the palette's solid at half opacity. `pulse` animates it, for a person who is speaking, and stops when the reader prefers reduced motion.
effect.title: Effects

palette.about: Every palette in every look. The looks are flat, because an avatar is read and not pressed. The palette and the look color the initials and their box, and a loaded picture covers both.
palette.title: Palettes and looks

pictures.about: A picture covers the box once it loads. Until then, and after it fails, the initials show, so a slow or broken picture never leaves an empty box.
pictures.title: Pictures and initials

presence.about: The dot is 28% of the avatar's side and never under 8px, so one dot fits a 24px avatar in a list and a 56px one on a profile.
presence.title: A status at every size

services.about: A service or a company takes a square or rounded box, and an icon in place of initials. The box keeps the name for a screen reader.
services.title: Services and companies

shape.about: A circle for a person, and a rounded or square box for a company, a service or a bot.
shape.title: Shapes

size.about: The side is a control height, so an avatar is as tall as a button of its size: 32, 36, 40, 44, 48 and 56px. `2xs` is 24px, for a byline or a list row. The initials take the label style of the same size.
size.title: Sizes

team.about: A group overlaps each avatar with the one before it by a quarter of its side and rings each in the panel's ground. The last avatar counts the people left out and is named for them.
team.title: A team

title: Avatar
